analysis: Q2 retrieved the correct row but chose a different year column. Preserve table headers and row structure; better retrieval alone did not fix the numerical answer.

Q6 and Q12 had correct raw answers but quotations failed validation. Q9 produced reasoning in its rewrite and repeated a question. Use contiguous quotes and a structured single-question rewrite rather than weakening source checks.

Q13 abstained in prose but used answered status with irrelevant citations. All three unsupported cases declined in meaning, but only two used a correct refusal status. Q11 answered meaningfully from an adjacent passage despite zero anchor recall, illustrating incomplete relevance labels.

Hybrid recall increased from 0.667 to 0.917 on twelve answerable cases; strict correctness was 10/15. The 15-question set is small and deliberately chosen. No semantic fallback occurred; this does not prove reliability across unseen documents.
